clock_rule: no timestamp subtraction across endpoint clocks
measurement_scope: isolated Linux loopback kernel path with tc/netem; paired order-alternated trials; client-clock completion and FIRST_BYTE acknowledgement timing; server-clock processing timing; combined in-process endpoint CPU; per-transfer root-qdisc byte and packet deltas
packet_accounting: tc -j -s root-qdisc counter delta around each isolated transfer; includes QUIC handshake, encrypted packets, acknowledgements, close traffic observed before helper return, and the 13-byte symmetric FIRST_BYTE measurement message
